name: Hypercare & Stabilization (SDLC Phase 12)
description: Post-launch support and stabilization — aka Post-Launch Support, Warranty Period, Hot Stage.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Hypercare & Stabilization
capabilities.description: Stabilizes the product after launch through active monitoring, rapid issue resolution, and structured retrospective learning.

checklists.name: Hypercare & Stabilization (SDLC Phase 12) Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for post-launch monitoring, defect resolution, and retrospective learning.

items.statement: Issues logged during hypercare are triaged and assigned an owner within the agreed response window.
All Sev-1 and Sev-2 post-launch incidents have completed blameless post-mortem reports with assigned action items.
Hotfix deployment pipeline is operational with automated smoke test verification.
Operational KPIs (uptime, latency, error rate) satisfy production SLA targets over 14 consecutive days.
Handover to ongoing operations team is formally completed with updated runbooks.

reviewGates.name: Hypercare Review
reviewGates.statement: The Post-Mortem & Lessons Learned report has been reviewed and accepted as sufficient to proceed to Growth & Optimization.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Post-Mortem & Lessons Learned report show the launch has stabilized sufficiently to justify moving into Growth & Optimization?
